summary: Iter 217 (Game SFX/Haptics P1 + Winners Ticker P2 + Streak Rewards P3) verified end-to-end on web and mobile against the shared backend. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass covering /api/games/streak shape+auth, /api/games/recent-wins (>=8 items, real-before-sample ordering, auth), streak once-per-UTC-day idempotency across wheel/scratch/dice (bonus.points == min(day,7)*10, 2nd play awarded=false), real-win recording to game_wins surfacing in ticker with sample=false, and regression that wheel segment_index, scratch tiles/win, and dining-dice die1/die2 are still returned. WEB /play-and-win renders StreakBadge (streak-badge, streak-count='1-day streak') and WinnersTicker (winners-ticker, winner-item-0) above the hero. WEB game pages (/games/wheel, /games/scratch, /dining/dice) load; wheel-prize-modal / wheel-streak-bonus / scratch-streak-bonus / dice-streak-bonus testIDs are all present in source and will fire on a user's first play of the day (freeuser consumed their day during backend tests, so the on-screen streak line was not re-asserted — expected). MOBILE /games renders flame StreakBadge + WinnersTicker alongside the pre-existing Daily Streak card as spec'd; wheel-prize-modal fires after SPIN; scratch-result renders a win card; trivia-game loads with no red-screen. No JS/console errors from expo-audio/expo-haptics on web preview (degrades gracefully). Streak bonus text lines on mobile intentionally hidden for demo because demo has already played today (per task note).

issues: Minor: on narrow viewports the streak-count label can wrap under the Bonus-claimed sub-label (cosmetic only, legible)

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking web-preview console warnings: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow', 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents', and 'Invalid DOM property transform-origin (did you mean transformOrigin?)'. These are RN-web transpilation warnings, do not cause red-screen. Likely upstream in a dependency / older style usage; worth tracking but no functional impact.

action_items: No functional changes required for iter 217 — ship-ready.

(Optional, non-blocking) Clean up RN-web console warnings on mobile: migrate 'shadow*' -> boxShadow, 'pointerEvents' prop -> style.pointerEvents, and the stray transform-origin DOM prop. These do not affect iter 217 flows.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/game_rewards.py:touch_streak correctly guards double-credit via PointsService idempotency_key 'streak:{uid}:{today}' AND skips bonus_spin counter increment on idempotency_hit — good; 2nd-play test confirms awarded=false.

touch_streak returns the same current_streak even when played_today==True (new_cur=cur) — the UI should treat bonus.awarded=false as 'already claimed' rather than reading streak_day==0 (confirmed: StreakBadge shows 'Bonus claimed today').
recent_wins uses stable Random(_day()) for sample shuffle — nice, keeps ticker visually stable within the UTC day.
record_game_win silently swallows all exceptions (try/except Exception: pass) — fine for a non-critical ticker write but consider logging at WARN so a broken index doesn't go unnoticed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical selectors verified; streak-bonus text line gated by first-play-of-day — not re-asserted after backend tests consumed the day
